correctness.rationale: Conditioning on transmit/drop branches gives the stated exact three-moment operator. Independent symbolic reconstruction gives \(\det(I-N)=p s[p s+2p-2s]\), so eigenvalue \(1\) appears precisely at \(s=2p/(2-p)\). The package supplies the remaining cubic Jury inequalities and a separate renewal proof for standard zero-residual initialization: geometric waiting time \(J\) yields cycle multiplier \(1-2s/p+(2-p)s^2/p^2\), which crosses one at the same threshold and is minimized at \(p/(2-p)\). The no-memory multiplier \(1-2ps+ps^2\) gives the comparison interval.

final_claim: For classic error feedback on a scalar quadratic with iid Bernoulli transmit-or-drop probability \(p\), the exact mean-square constant-step stability interval is \(0<\eta\mu<2p/(2-p)\); the communication-cycle multiplier is minimized at \(\eta\mu=p/(2-p)\), while the corresponding memoryless dropout iteration remains stable for \(0<\eta\mu<2\).
limitations: Scalar deterministic quadratic, iid Bernoulli compressor, constant step.
